units.source_text: 驹子从岛村身旁飞奔出来。

en.t: Komako came rushing out from beside Shimamura.

units.source_text: 这与她捂住眼睛惊叫差不多在同一瞬间。

en.t: It happened almost at the same instant that she covered her eyes and cried out.

units.source_text: 也正是人们“啊”地一声倒抽一口冷气的时候。

en.t: It was also just when the people gasped with a sharp ah.
